# Lorenz Espinosa — IT Systems & Automation Consultant
> Expanded public profile: /llms-full.txt

I work on IT systems and connect tools teams already use. Projects are scoped around a practical handoff, with testing for missing data and failures, documentation and human review when decisions matter. I work with small teams and larger organizations from the Philippines and can work remotely with English-speaking teams.

## Services
- Workflow review: map the process, connected tools and exceptions. Scope and terms are agreed before work begins.
- Scoped systems integration and automation implementation, with pricing quoted for the project.
- Ongoing systems support when agreed, with scope and terms set for the engagement.

## Public code example
- [n8n-lint](https://github.com/lorenzespinosa/n8n-lint): a JavaScript CLI for checking n8n workflow files before import. Findings need human review; this tool is not evidence of client deployments or results.
